tagline: Scenes in SVG, written in YAML
brief: A CLI that compiles a YAML scene into an SVG, with warnings, art-director critiques and a text description, so an AI that cannot see images can still illustrate. It runs on the CPU only, with no models.
criteria: Success: recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, speaks of scenes and paths, distinct from generic AI marks.

concepts.name: Path
concepts.idea: An S drawn as a path with a checkpoint at each end: a scene is a journey.
rationale: Reads as the letter S and as a route, with no explanation needed
The ringed discs are the checkpoints of scenec's 2.5D mode
Colours come from the flat-autumn theme: ink brown, terracotta and amber

recommendation: Path: the only mark that carries the idea of the project and is still a letter.
next_steps: Apply it to the README and the site
Use the favicon and app icon from the kit
